Prepare step by step

  1. Put immediate safety and the person’s choices first.
  2. Clarify who may receive, discuss or act on information before sharing anything.
  3. Separate care, records, benefits, home access, transportation and legal questions.
  4. Confirm current provider, program, credential and service details directly.

No medical, capacity, consent, guardianship, benefit or legal determination is made here.
